detailed_descriptions.en: Saleblazers is an adventure shopkeeping survival game for 1-8 players. Survive a Dangerous Fantasy World as a Shopkeeper You’re a humble shopkeeper trying to live a peaceful new life, finding yourself surrounded by warring factions and dangerous creatures. Will you be able to carve out a new home for yourself and your customers? Dynamic Combat Physics Use heavy hitting melee and ranged attacks to knock enemies down! A Living World NPCs will react to every action inside your shop and out. Commit too many crimes, and they'll even call on the police to take you to jail! KEY FEATURES Dedicated server support (see Steam Community guide for details). Play as a Knight, Gunslinger, or Mage with all sorts of item builds to explore! Immersive world with many handcrafted villages to explore. Sell anything. NPCs dynamically react to your actions! Use anything as a weapon. Build and run multiple shops across the island. Hire employees to run your store for you. Wire up electric items for powerful late-game items such as self-checkout machines or turrets. Gather, fish, farm, craft, buy, or loot to stock your shelves. Verified on Steam Deck!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Saleblazers is an adventure shopkeeping survival game for 1-8 players.

Survive a Dangerous Fantasy World as a Shopkeeper

You’re a humble shopkeeper trying to live a peaceful new life, finding yourself surrounded by warring factions and dangerous creatures. Will you be able to carve out a new home for yourself and your customers?

Dynamic Combat Physics

Use heavy hitting melee and ranged attacks to knock enemies down!

A Living World

NPCs will react to every action inside your shop and out. Commit too many crimes, and they'll even call on the police to take you to jail!

KEY FEATURES

  • Dedicated server support (see Steam Community guide for details).

  • Play as a Knight, Gunslinger, or Mage with all sorts of item builds to explore!

  • Immersive world with many handcrafted villages to explore.

  • Sell anything.

  • NPCs dynamically react to your actions!

  • Use anything as a weapon.

  • Build and run multiple shops across the island.

  • Hire employees to run your store for you.

  • Wire up electric items for powerful late-game items such as self-checkout machines or turrets.

  • Gather, fish, farm, craft, buy, or loot to stock your shelves.

Verified on Steam Deck!
